map.输入数据集，计算 Q1、Q2、Q3 与四分位距 IQR，并据 1.5×IQR 规: Enter a data set to compute Q1, Q2, Q3 and the interquartile range IQR, and mark the outlier bounds by the 1.5xIQR rule; used for boxplots and outlier detection.
map.IQR = Q3 − Q1；异常值下限 = Q1 − 1.5×IQR；异常值上限: IQR = Q3 - Q1; outlier lower bound = Q1 - 1.5xIQR; outlier upper bound = Q3 + 1.5xIQR
map.四分位距 IQR 是第三四分位数与第一四分位数之差，描述数据中间 50% 的分布: The interquartile range IQR is the difference between the third and first quartiles, describing the span of the middle 50% of the data and more robust than the range. Under Tukey's 1.5xIQR rule, observations below Q1 - 1.5xIQR or above Q3 + 1.5xIQR are treated as outliers; used for boxplot whiskers and outlier identification.
map.IQR=Q3−Q1，中间 50% 数据跨度。: IQR = Q3 - Q1, the span of the middle 50% of the data.
map.对偏态比极差稳健。: More robust than the range for skewed data.

map.Tukey 经验法则，箱线图标准，约对应正态下 ±2.7σ，非严格统计检验。: Tukey's empirical rule, the boxplot standard, roughly corresponds to +/-2.7 sigma under normality; it is not a strict statistical test.
